source_config.allocation: next open: repeat highest affordable valid candidate, multiple independent lots allowed
source_config.cancellation_rule: retrospective same-day plan review using closing/settlement data; remove lowest original expected_gap first; replay retained openings from pre-entry Ledger checkpoint; if no new entries remain, close existing positions by original rule; not a tradable cancellation of already filled ETF
source_config.costs: actual raw ETF execution; future adverse1tick; zero ETF fee/slippage; no dividends/share adjustments or complete fees
source_config.dividend_accounting: record-close holdings; ex-date receivable; payment-date gross cash available at day start; sold holdings retain claims; no reinvestment or withholding tax; ex-post metadata known_at not historical PIT
source_config.etf_execution: raw ETF open for ordinary trades, close for emergency/delivery; zero ETF fee/slippage unchanged cost baseline; T1 sell constraint; no dividends/share adjustments
source_config.etf_quantity: floor(entry index open * futures multiplier / ETF open /100)*100; frozen per group
source_config.funding_exit_rule: project end-of-day settlement cash; closest absolute annualized-rate distance to own frozen exit; repeat until budget nonnegative; close +/-tick before settlement; emergency cash immediately covers deficit, no further entries today; ordinary exits retain T1 lock
source_config.priority: previous completed close actual annualized premium minus selected frozen exit threshold; ties product code
source_config.release: cash-leg sale and freed margin plus closing future cashflow locked until next observed trading date; emergency immediate liquidity exception
source_config.repo: calendar daily positive Ledger cash minus current margin minus T1 locks; ETF purchase already debited from cash
source_config.selection: daily independent 35-pair trailing-year model inherited; includes prior fully-flat repo model; actual portfolio residual cash repo is separate

source_snapshots.capital: 1.5*entry index open*multiplier; maximum single executed combination per product
source_snapshots.costs: gross and future one-tick only; complete fees/ETF costs/dividends/financing excluded
source_snapshots.returns: fixed initial reserve equal full-history capital peak; calendar CAGR; annual PnL / opening equity
source_snapshots.scope: nearest listed not-yet-expired actual contract; expiry day retains old front
source_snapshots.timing: completed close -> next observed day open; no automatic roll or reentry on exit date

selection_policy: previously recorded trailing-year daily winners; never backfill latest thresholds
